decision.rationale: Staggered probe action-2 showed no_mismatch_observed with probe_rmse 0.0748C, and recorded_mismatches remains empty, so initial model not yet rejected on that input; training fits alone cannot establish mechanism, with sensor_lag RMSE 0.079 vs 0.42 for linear/quadratic_loss on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2; need independent diagnostic on different schedule to continue bounded mismatch search.
